liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Robot Stop** (1 other source): Ambrose played saxophone; the song included teases for Sad Pilot, Converge, and Witchcraft [1]

## Setlist highlights

- **Banter (Donkeys)**: rare: 6 archived performances [4]
- **You Can Be Your Silhouette**: rare: 8 archived performances [4]
- **Banter (Screen)**: rare: 6 archived performances [4]
- **Banter (Malört)**: rare: 6 archived performances [4]
- **Banter (Banana Hat)**: rare: 6 archived performances [4]
- **Banter (No Repeats)**: rare: 6 archived performances [4]
- **Welcome to an Altered Future**: back after 129 archived shows (2366 days); rare: 11 archived performances [4]
- **Banter (Deep House Dungeon Rave)**: rare: 6 archived performances [4]

## The recordings

- **kglw2024-09-01.SP-CMC-2** (recommended): source not stated; 35 songs; 196 min [1]
- **kglw2024-09-01.mk21.flac24**: source not stated; 28 songs; 197 min [2]
- **kglw2024-09-01**: source not stated; 28 songs; 196 min [3]

## Tapers and lineage

- **kglw2024-09-01.SP-CMC-2**: taped by Goomblsnax_II; transferred by Goomblsnax_II; source: SP-CMC-2 > SP-SPSB-10 > Roland R-07 (24/96 WAV) > microSD [1]
- **kglw2024-09-01.mk21.flac24**: taped by Brian Porter; source: Schoeps mk21 (FOB/ORTF wide) > kcy > Sonosax SX-M2/LS2 > Sony M10 (24/96) [2]
- **kglw2024-09-01**: taped by Revinylize [3]. Also: Tascam DR-40 recorded in XY configuration at 24bit/48kHz [3]

- Poster by Musicdope80s.com: [King Gizzard And The Lizard Wizard On Sept 1 2024 Huntington Bank Pavilion Chicago Il Poster](https://musicdope80s.com/king-gizzard-and-the-lizard-wizard-on-sept-1-2024-huntington-bank-pavilion-chicago-il-poster/) [5]

- Poster by Teesprime: [Original King Gizzard And The Lizard Wizard On Sept 1 2024 Huntington Bank Pavilion Chicago IL Poster T Shirt, hoodie, s](https://teesprime.com/product/original-king-gizzard-and-the-lizard-wizard-on-sept-1-2024-huntington-bank-pavilion-chicago-il-poster-t-shirt/) [8]
